title: 0xai
tagline: 0xAi is a ai platform which enables dev to convert their Dapps to ai agent.
description:
0xAi is an Ai Platform where users /dev can convert their dapps into ai agents with using of mcp.
NOTE: We not able to build this fully but we still take this project into life by next month.

How its work?
Every Dapps have smart contract and this smart contract will convert into a mcp server so they plug into llm.Which unlock the new potential of a platfrom. In this platform user just chat in any language it supports 22+ language and currently it ready the data from blockchain and summarize it in users language like hindi, spanish, tamil and many more.

We working to let user sign tx and do onchain tx with just one prompt.

Why This Platform?
We all know that biggest pain point in the blockchain industry is adoption. We are not able to oboard the non tech users in this industry. So for this problem we use ai to solve this and ai best choice for this because everyone using ai in everyday life we just need to create a platform which can interact with people and solve their problem.
how_its_made:
we used next js and express , etherjs ,wagmi, Reown appkit.
Ether js for interact with blockchian data and wagi also known for low latency this is my favourite one.
Reown Appkit also give a good experience in user onboarding . It have neat and good interface..
I use these stack in many projects.
